name: Nathaniel Moran

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Historic March for Life yesterday. Life begins at conception. Let’s work to protect it. #proudlyprolife #overturnRoe"

"The nation cheered when the Supreme Court overturned Roe vs. Wade, but Democrats immediately started planning ways to thwart pro-life efforts. Now, more than ever, it is vital to have dedicated pro-life members of Congress. Join the fight for life by voting Moran for Congress!"
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "If you take out student loans, you're expected to pay for the loans - not the American taxpayers."
"It is not the responsibility of hardworking Americans who did not take out student loans to repay loans for those who did. Biden's student loan bailout scheme is illegal."

"No taxpaying American should be obligated to pay for another person's student loans. This afternoon, I joined my colleagues on the House Floor to support H.J.Res.45, which would repeal President Biden's unconstitutional student loan program."

"The idea that American taxpayers should bear the burden of student loans from individuals who willingly accepted them is absurd, and I will not stand by as the Biden Admin continues to push its unconstitutional student loan forgiveness program."

evidence.text: "Our democracy is only as strong as our trust in the voting system. We need to increase accountability in the election process through voter ID nationwide, accurate voter rolls, and observer access."

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "After a first-hand visit to the border, I am more convinced than ever that this must be a top priority when Republicans take the majority in November."

"I appreciated the opportunity to speak to the Harrison County Republican Women about what I learned on my recent trip to the border. Did you know that over 22,900 pounds of Fentanyl were seized in FY22 alone? We must fix our porous border and stop the cartels and traffickers."
"We can’t let Democrats in Washington ignore the crisis at our border with Mexico any longer. Border security will be a day-one priority, and I will fight to enforce the rule of law at our borders."

"We can’t let Democrats in Washington ignore the crisis at our border with Mexico any longer. We need to fully fund effective border enforcement strategies, infrastructure, and advanced technology to prevent illegal crossings and trafficking by cartels."

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship, regardless of their immigration status?

evidence.text: "Over one MILLION illegal migrants have been encountered at the southern border in just four and a half months - a 20% increase compared to last fiscal year. When will enough be enough? The Biden Administration needs to take action NOW."

"Proud to introduce my first piece of legislation this evening, the Border Security Investment Act - the first step in funding border security, decreasing the national deficit, and disincentivizing illegal immigration."

"The United States must be a nation that enforces the Rule-of-Law. Unfortunately, Democratic leaders across the country have neglected to enforce the law which has led to a rise in violent crime in major cities and added to the influx of illegal immigration at our southern border."
Rated 92% by NumbersUSA
